membership.quote:
Section  1. There is hereby established the Federal Financing Bank  
Advisory Council. The Council shall consist of:
(1 ) The Secretary of the Treasury (Chairman).
(2 ) The Secretary of Agriculture.
(3 ) The Secretary of Commerce.
(4 ) The Secretary of Health, Education, and Welfare.
(5 ) The Secretary of Housing and Urban Development.
(6 ) The Secretary of Transportation.
(7 ) The President of the Export-Import Bank of the United States.
(8 ) The Postmaster General.

bank_basis.quote:
Sec. 2. The Council shall provide advice and assistance to the Board  
of Directors of the Federal Financing Bank established by the Federal  
Financing Bank Act of 1973 (Public Law 93-224 ; 87 Stat. 937) con­
cerning the administration of that act. It shall also serve as a coordinat­
ing forum to insure a broader understanding of, and support for, the  
Bank.

support.quote:
Sec . 3. The Department of the Treasury shall, to the extent permitted  
by law, provide administrative support for the Council.

revocation.quote:
Sec. 15. Executive Order No. 11782, establishing the Federal Financing Bank  
Advisory Council, is revoked.

findings: The original has three substantive sections: establishment and eight named federal-official members; advice/assistance and coordination concerning the separately established Bank; Treasury administrative support subject to law. No sunset, report duty, completion condition, or executed predecessor revocation appears.

The original roster consists of federal officers. The held FACA definition expressly excludes committees composed wholly of full-time federal officers or employees. Its generic two-year termination provision therefore does not supply a cessation date for this Council. The damaged definition heading is OCR, while the exclusion wording is unambiguous.

The FACA archive path is a 134-byte LFS pointer, not the PDF. Its official-fixity row is not_listed because GPO PREMIS lists the package PDF rather than this single-document PDF. That custody limitation is not evidence that FACA applies or that a generic sunset is legally unresolved.

EO12379 section 15 expressly revokes this order; the complete actor contains no deferral or savings for the target. The source supports 1982-08-17 formal revocation. The cleanup preamble alone does not prove a separate earlier legal cessation.

The original expressly identifies the Federal Financing Bank as established by the Federal Financing Bank Act of 1973. Its continued statutory existence is distinct from continuation of the advisory Council. No language in either read order purports to revoke the Bank statute, and generic Bank residual speculation should not create a legal blocker.

The HEW named seat is an actual historical office-reference issue potentially relevant to the precise membership wording; the held original/actor do not determine its successor mechanics. No inference that an office rename or successor arrangement ended the Council is justified. The underlying reorganization statute was not located/read here, so no exact amendment or first-end date is asserted for the seat.

Both EO official extracts are complete and legally unambiguous on establishment, duties and express revocation; matching issue-PDF fixity is present. Absent page images must be disclosed but, under this assignment, are not alone a substantive legal blocker.

Target EDGES show only EO12379. Machine OFR/text scopes are useful bounded searches, not exhaustive proof against unnamed statutes. The actual USC release scope ends 2026-10-09; the combined tracker label must not be read as USC coverage through 2026-10-14. A five-day general search gap is not positive evidence of revival.
